# goslop text fixture — CWE-73 CLI main() with Path(sys.argv[1]) under __main__
lang: python
file: scripts/parva_offline_verify.py
---
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def main() -> int:
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        print("usage: verify <bundle>")
        return 2
    root = Path(sys.argv[1])
    manifest_path = root / "bundle-manifest.json"
    if not manifest_path.exists():
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
